name: Tocsin
description: The alarm bell: two hard shells round a dense core, nothing soft about it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 24%; height: 24%; margin: 38%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 calc(4px * 6 / @size-col) @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)), 0 0 0 calc(9px * 6 / @size-col) @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
